Asclepius of Tralles
Asclepius of
Tralles
(
Greek
:
Ἀσκληπιός
; died c. 560–570) was a
Neoplatonic
philosopher
and
mathematician
who was a student of
Ammonius Hermiae
. Two works of his survive:
Both works seem to be notes on the lectures conducted by
Ammonius
.
